article.title: Application of certain provisions to proceedings under section 241 or section 245.
article.content: The provisions of sections 337 to 341 (both inclusive) shall apply mutatis mutandis, in relation to an application made to the Tribunal under section 241 or section 245.
article.html:
246Application of certain provisions to proceedings under section 241 or section 245.

Section 246 · Chapter XVI · page 165 of the Act

The provisions of sections 337 to 341 (both inclusive) shall apply mutatis mutandis, in relation to an application made to the Tribunal under section 241 or section 245.
